highlights: Over $130k refurbishment in 2025 by Avus Autosport with detailed invoices
Engine overhaul with dual Weber carburetors and tubular headers
Suspension refresh including Koni shocks, polyurethane bushings, Brembo master cylinder
Rare non-factory green over beige leather combination with flying buttress seats
red_flags: Commenters point out visible rust on outer rockers despite claimed rocker replacement during restoration
Alleged sloppy patch work on spare tire well and incorrect floor stampings affecting structural rigidity
Noticeable orange peel throughout the repaint acknowledged by the seller
Oil drip visible on a suspension bolt in photos
Invoice pages 7-8 withheld by seller, limiting full documentation transparency
normalized.prelim_summary: This 1974 Alfa Romeo GTV 2000 sold for $75,000 after an extensive, well-documented $130k refurbishment covering the engine, suspension, and interior. However, forum commenters raised credible concerns about visible rust on the rockers, questionable panel repair quality, and an imperfect repaint, suggesting the cosmetic and structural work may not fully match the price paid.
